text:
ana: Pushing a GA announcement for a new Hosted model family: lowcost-quant-v1 is now live. :tada:
ana: Summary: up to ~3-4x token cost reduction for typical chat/short-context workloads, streaming + tool-calling supported, KV-prefix caching enabled. Docs: https://internal.redwood.ai/docs/hosted/lowcost-quant-v1
ana: API usage unchanged except model param: POST /v1/generate?model=lowcost-quant-v1. Optional header: X-Quant-Profile: compact|balanced|throughput for extra tuning.
mike: Deployment detail: quant kernel bundle rolled at 1936123600. You may see kernel-negotiation fallbacks on older hosts; those requests will be routed to compatible kernels automatically.
mike: Perf tips: prefer auto batch sizing or set max_batch_tokens to 2048 for steady P95. Example runtime hint: model.params = {"max_batch_tokens": 2048, "kv_cache": "auto"}
jamal: Canary caught one function-calling edge-case: when callers send an empty arguments object we returned an error instead of forwarding. Repro: {"input":"lookup","tool_call":{"name":"user.get","arguments":{}}}
jamal: Filed RED-9082 and added a failing unit test.
ana: Eng-runtime owns RED-9082. Target patch EOD. Automatic fallback to standard-v1 enabled for GA customers if regressions surface.
sre-ops: Created dashboards and alerts: internal link https://internal.redwood.ai/dashboards/lowcost-quant. Alerts: decode_latency_p95 > 800ms or error_rate > 0.5% -> pager. Also adding a synthetic that exercises tool-calling paths.
mike: Note on throttles: brief burst throttling enabled to protect host SLOs during rollout.
deploy-bot: deployment/redwood/runtime/lowcost-quant v1.0.3 deployed (job 87921) :rocket:
eva: Customer comms plan: in-app banner for self-serve with >100k tokens/mo, email to high-usage tenants, and an enterprise note to CSMs with migration guidance.
devx: I'll add lowcost-quant-v1 to SDK dropdowns and put a sample showing tool-calling. Will open PR for quickstart.
nana: Support KB migration steps: switch model param, optionally set X-Quant-Profile, cap max_tokens during initial rollout. Deprecation: quant-slim-v0 -> deprecated in 90 days; we'll auto-route legacy traffic to standard-v1 if unpatched.
nana: Thanks to runtime, infra, and devx for the push. Special shoutout to jamal for catching the tool-call repro and mike for the kernel work. :clap:
